slides.title: •  Potential Energy: Potential energy of a body is its capacity to do work in virtue

visualInspection.notes: Printed 6 potential energy is force work from current r to reference r0: integral lower bound r, upper r0. Total E=K+U. Definition requires conservative position-dependent force for a single-valued potential; do not reverse the integral limits or confuse E with L. Actual 1800×1013 rendered pixels were viewed; not an extraction-only inspection.

slides.title: Dynamic equation of a manipulator

visualInspection.notes: Printed 8 link kinetic energy is COM translation plus COM spin quadratic form, with arrows to each term; sum over all links. Angular velocity and inertia must share a coordinate basis; use COM inertia rather than double-counting joint-axis inertia.
